projects.name: NCDOT 2026-2035 STIP Lines
projects.notes: Current 10-year STIP. There is no explicit phase/status field: 'Category' is the funding category (value 'Not Funded' marks unfunded projects) and 'Symbology' is category+mode. The work actually done is only in the free-text 'Description'. 'Mode' = Highway / Rail / Ferry / Public Transportation (Transit) / Bike & Ped / Aviation. Timing comes from the text fields 'RightOfWayYear' and 'ConstructionYear' (a year such as '2029', or 'NOT FUNDED', 'POST YEAR', 'FUNDED FOR PRELIMINARY ENGINEERING ONLY', or blank); years before the current one mean already under way. RightOfWayYear in the future is the best signal of upcoming land acquisition. maxRecordCount 1000.

projects.name: NCDOT 2026-2035 STIP Points
projects.notes: Same schema as the lines layer (geometry type is multipoint). Point projects: bridges, intersections, interchanges.

parcels_statewide.name: NC OneMap Parcels (polys)
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide, all counties, standardized by NC OneMap from county assessors. In the sample record the whole mailing address was in 'mailadd' and mcity/mstate/mzip were blank; this varies by county. Also 'ownname2', 'altparno', 'nparno' (FIPS-prefixed id), 'landval', 'improvval', 'parusedesc', 'saledate'. Layer 0 of the same service is parcel centroids. maxRecordCount 5000. No use restriction stated on the service.

summary: Both needs are met statewide: the NCDOT 2026-2035 STIP (lines and points, with right-of-way and construction years and cost) and NC OneMap parcels with owner name and mailing address. The STIP has no work-type field; type of work must be read from the description.
